description: Look up one country's headline tax rates: GST/VAT standard and reduced rates, top personal income tax rate, and company tax rate — national rates for 193 countries, plus state and provincial sales tax for CA and US when you pass region. Use it for a single country; to see several countries side by side use compare_countries, and to apply GST/VAT to an amount use compute_gst_vat. Rates come from a fixed dataset verified against the national tax authority — every answer names its source and verification date, and an unsupported country returns a clear error rather than a guess.

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country to look up (case-insensitive)

region.description: Optional state or province code, for sub-national sales tax. Held for CA (13 provinces and territories), US (51 states incl. DC). E.g. 'ON' (Ontario) with country CA, or 'CA' (California) with country US. Answered from that state's or province's own cited rate; US figures are the state rate only — local sales taxes are not included.

name: tax_rate_lookup

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

incomeTopRate.description: Top personal income tax rate (display string; may note surcharges)

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

reducedRates.description: Reduced rates as fractions; empty when none

region.description: Present only when region was passed: the state or provincial sales tax, with its OWN source and date

combinedRate.description: What a buyer pays in total: in Canada the provincial rate plus the 5% GST (or the single HST); in the US the state rate (local taxes not included)

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the regional rate was last checked

effectiveFrom.description: ISO date the rate took effect

mayBeStale.description: True when that date is over a year old, or the rate is unverified

name.description: What applies there, in a sentence

source.description: Authority the regional rate was verified against — says 'not verified' when it was not

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page — present only for verified rates

standardRate.description: The state or provincial rate alone, as a fraction

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

standardRate.description: Standard consumption-tax rate as a fraction (0.1 = 10%)

taxFamily.description: Consumption-tax family, e.g. 'GST', 'VAT' or a non-VAT system like retail sales tax

title: Country tax rate lookup
